name: @grimworld/app
description: Client shell: React, PixiJS rendered on demand, starknet.js for the chain (ADR-0003, ADR-0007).

scripts.test:node:devnet: cd ../.. && scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'python3 scripts/devnet_deploy.py --out "$PWD/.with-node/deployment.json" && GRIMWORLD_DEPLOYMENT="$PWD/.with-node/deployment.json" pnpm --filter @grimworld/app test:node:preview'
scripts.verify:chain: cd ../.. && scripts/with-node.sh bash -c 'python3 scripts/devnet_deploy.py --out "$PWD/.with-node/deployment.json" && GRIMWORLD_DEPLOYMENT="$PWD/.with-node/deployment.json" pnpm --filter @grimworld/app exec node verify-chain.mjs'
